text:
Conan O'Brien swapped his usual Omega for a Rolex at the Oscars.

He wore the Land-Dweller 40, a steel and white gold model with a white dial. US retail is $16,450, but dealers ask much more for it now.

Would you wear a Rolex to the Oscars? Tell us below.
